cards.title: Approaching Padre Balli Park
instructions: Padre Balli Park is the old Bob Hall Pier
Keep paralleling the beach line at ½ WTD, 5,500 ft, 240 KIAS
cards.detail: Padre Balli Park is not in the KML; its map position is approximate.
cards.source: Binder, p. 22; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 1, slide 80.

cards.title: Abeam Padre Balli Park: switch to CH 17
cards.leadIn: Abeam Padre Balli Park, auto-switch to CH 17 (no check-in on CH 17 is required). Expect ATC to switch you. If not directed, request the switch:

exchange.speaker: Pilot
exchange.text: Corpus Departure, <callsign>, abeam Padre Balli Park, request switch CH 17.

exchange.speaker: Departure
exchange.text: <callsign>, Corpus Departure, contact approach / change to my frequency, CH 17.

exchange.speaker: Pilot
exchange.text: Corpus Approach, <callsign>, on CH 17 for Mustang {to.area.spoken}.

cards.title: Turn into {to.area}
instructions: Climb to your working altitude once established under the area
cards.source: Binder, p. 22; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 1, slide 80.
